title: EventEnvelopeV1
description: Canonical event envelope shared between Mashgate and HookLine. See docs/specs/event-envelope-v1.md for the mapping rules from Mashgate event schemas, Kafka records, and HookLine stored events. Governed by ADR-0013.

id.description: Unique envelope identifier (UUID v4). Canonical event id used across Mashgate and HookLine.

event_id.description: Alias for `id`. Must equal `id`. Preserved for backward compatibility with Mashgate event schemas and Kafka `event_id` header.

topic.description: Routing key in the form `<product>.<resource>.<verb>` (e.g. `payments.payment.completed`, `crm.contact.created`). Same string used as Kafka topic segment and HookLine subscription pattern.

tenant_id.description: Owning tenant. Enforced at every storage/delivery boundary per ADR-0002 §8.

occurred_at.description: Unix epoch in milliseconds. When the event actually happened in the business domain (set by the producer).

created_at.description: Unix epoch in milliseconds. When the envelope was serialized (server clock at the producer). Always >= occurred_at.

payload.description: Business-specific event data. Shape is defined per-topic by a sibling schema in contracts/events/. May be empty for marker events.

idempotency_key.description: Optional producer-provided key for deduplication. Two events with the same (tenant_id, idempotency_key) must be treated as the same event.

source.description: Optional symbolic name of the producing service (e.g. `ledger-core`, `checkout-service`). Used for observability and debugging.

event_type.description: Optional narrower event type within a topic (e.g. `payment.completed`). If omitted, consumers should assume topic is the event type.

event_version.description: Optional version of the payload schema. Increment on breaking payload changes; topic naming should also bump if routing needs to fork.

_trace.description: Optional W3C Trace Context propagation. When present, consumers must propagate these values into downstream calls. Required when the producer received an upstream traceparent.
